Messages.Author: 1st.:BLOOD:.Thirster
Messages.Body:
A small question if I take an action with a Blackhand vamp with
dominion and someone tries to block it, the blocking vamp burns 1
blood right. But now I play mask with another Black hand vamp with
dominion does the blocking vamp burn 1 more blood?

I think not, but it is worth the question.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Cannot Mask after the Dominion effect is applied, since only that
acting vampire has that copy of Dominion.
